units.source_text: “对，对，记得有个讨厌的学生哥，让别人打扫房间，他却直勾勾地望着人家。

en.t: Yes, yes, I remember there was an annoying student who made other people clean the room while he just stared straight at them.

units.source_text: 人家让他躲开，他却说：偶尔吸点灰尘也好嘛。

en.t: When they told him to get out of the way, he said, It is good to breathe in a little dust once in a while.

units.source_text: 还说什么山里的空气太新鲜了，扬起一点尘埃倒有点城市的气氛。

en.t: He even said the mountain air was too fresh, and that a bit of dust in the air actually gave it something of a city atmosphere.

units.source_text: 赶巧阿雪过来擦地板，说：‘那么，这桶脏水是什么气氛？’

en.t: Just then, Ayuki came over to wipe the floor and said, Then what kind of atmosphere is this bucket of dirty water?

units.source_text: 这个坏姑娘问得好，可不是嘛……

en.t: That naughty girl asked exactly the right question, did she not?

units.source_text: 喂，仓吉，你挺舒坦的，望着阿雪，体验到什么气氛啦？”

en.t: Hey, Kurakichi, you look quite comfortable. Staring at Ayuki, what kind of atmosphere did you experience?
